description: Particles sliding along one or more SVG dashed paths, like electrons on a subway-line diagram. The path itself optionally draws itself in via stroke-dashoffset, then particles flow along it with offset-path motion. Built for vox-style microscopic/macroscopic motion-diagram scenes.

paths.description: SVG path d-strings; one path per subway line. Particles are distributed evenly across all paths.

labels.description: optional per-path label rendered beside the path's midpoint

strokeColorToken.description: color token for the dashed path lines

dashArray.description: dash length in SVG user units

dashGap.description: gap length in SVG user units

drawDurationFraction.description: fraction of the asset's active window spent drawing the path(s) in; particles start emitting after

particleColorToken.description: color token for the flowing particles

particleLagFrames.description: frames between consecutive particle departures along the path

loopParticles.description: when true particles wrap and re-emit; when false they exit at path end

easing.description: easing token driving the path-draw-in animation
